title: dep-scan decisions file
description: The parsed shape of a dep-scan decisions file (.depscan/decisions.toml). The TOML file holds three kinds of statement people make about findings: triage decisions, the baseline that marks findings new or existing, and the expectations the gate evaluates. This schema validates the document after the TOML is parsed, so a TOML table becomes a JSON object and an array of tables becomes an array. A decision with proposed_by and no approver is a proposal that changes nothing until a person approves it, whatever its author says; every other decision is live and names its author.

finding.description: Selects one finding by its dsf1 fingerprint.

advisory.description: Selects findings hit by this advisory id or one of its aliases, for example CVE-2021-23337 or a GHSA id. Requires purl.

purl.description: Selects findings whose affected component is this package, compared with comparable_purl. A version in the purl pins the component version. Requires advisory.

version_range.description: Narrows the purl selection to versions inside this range, in vers syntax with the scheme of the purl type, for example vers:npm/>=4.17.0|<4.17.21. Requires purl.

state.description: The impact analysis state, from the CycloneDX 1.7 impactAnalysisState enum.

justification.description: The impact analysis justification, from the CycloneDX 1.7 impactAnalysisJustification enum. Required when the state is not_affected.

items.description: One response to the finding, from the CycloneDX 1.7 response enum.

responses.description: The responses chosen for this decision.

detail.description: Free-form detail about the decision, including why the component is not affected.

author.description: The person who made the decision. Required on a decision without proposed_by. On a proposal it records who wrote it and approves nothing; depscan triage review sets it to the approver when it is missing.

approver.description: The person who approved a proposed decision. depscan triage review writes it.

proposed_by.description: Who or what proposed the decision: a person, or an agent with its session. A decision with proposed_by and no approver is a proposal.

created.description: When the decision was recorded, as an RFC 3339 date-time.

expires.description: When the decision expires and the finding returns to triage, as an RFC 3339 date-time. An expired decision does not suppress and the scan warns about it.

triage.description: The triage decisions. not_affected, false_positive and resolved suppress the finding from the gate; in_triage and exploitable never do.

scan.description: The reference scan: a scan directory (its depscan.findings.json is read) or a depscan.findings.json path, relative to the decisions file.

digest.description: The SHA-256 hex digest of the baseline findings file. A mismatch stops the run.

baseline.description: The baseline findings that mark every finding new or existing by fingerprint.

id.description: The expectation's id, named by the gate result: letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen. Ids are unique across the expect and require entries; --fail-on entries take ids of the form fail-on:<n>, which this pattern cannot produce.

description.description: What the expectation asks for, in one sentence.

action.description: fail exits 3 when the expectation matches a finding; warn reports the match and keeps the exit code.

severity.description: A floor: matches findings at this severity or more severe.

grade.description: A floor on the exploitability grade: matches findings graded at this grade or more severe.

reach.description: Matches findings by the reachability axis: reached means proven or likely, not_reached means unlikely or refuted, not_assessed means the axis was not assessed. A reach assessed as unknown matches none of the three.

malware.description: true matches findings of the malware category.

rule.description: Matches findings whose rule id, advisory id or an advisory alias is named here.

purl.description: Matches findings whose affected component is this package, compared with comparable_purl. A version in the purl pins the component version.

version_range.description: Narrows the purl selection to versions inside this range, in vers syntax with the scheme of the purl type. Requires purl.

confidence.description: A floor on the producer confidence. A finding without confidence matches no floor.

new.description: true selects only findings the baseline does not contain; false selects only findings it does. The run needs a baseline, or the expectation is reported as not evaluated.

expect.description: The expectations the gate evaluates. The selectors combine with AND.

id.description: The requirement's id; require-<capability>, with -<project_type> when one is named, when absent. Ids are unique across the expect and require entries.

description.description: What the requirement asks for, in one sentence.

capability.description: A check that must have been assessed by the scan the gate reads: a --checks name that a scan stage records in the manifest when it assessed it. memory-safety, mobile, code and crypto are not assessed by dep-scan yet and are refused.

project_type.description: Restricts the requirement to one project type. A type the scan did not run leaves the requirement not evaluated.

require.description: The capabilities that must be assessed. A requirement that was not assessed exits 4.
